items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (Monk Rowe), not the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk. There is no mention of Thelonious Monk in the transcript.

ctx.x: All right. I’m going to start again and we’ll snip out the other stuff with a razor blade. My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and we are from one coast to the next, happy to have David Friesen here with me this afternoon, bassist and composer. Welcome, sir.
It’s good to be here. Good to meet you, Monk.

I was going to start off with — I have the Grove Dictionary of Jazz and the All Music Guide to Jazz and you are mentioned in both of them. And I was going to read an excerpt but then I thought what if you had the opportunity to write your own entry for the Grove Dictionary of Jazz? How would you use to describe your music? What would you say succinctly to sort of sum up your philosophy about music? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
